subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should #99912 remain scoped as a scheduled per-agent heartbeat routing bug, or be narrowed to the documented untargeted system-event CLI behavior before any fix is queued?
rationale: Current source and shipped tests support the intended scheduled per-agent path, while the latest reporter comment uses a manual command that docs say defaults to main, so maintainer/live proof must choose the real failing path.

options.title: Run live path split
options.body: Reproduce current main in Docker across scheduled heartbeat, targeted sessionKey wake, and untargeted system event before authorizing a fix.

options.title: Narrow to CLI behavior
options.body: Treat the manual system-event result as expected main-session behavior and keep only independently proven scheduled heartbeat failures in scope.

recommendation.title: Run live path split
recommendation.body: Reproduce current main in Docker across scheduled heartbeat, targeted sessionKey wake, and untargeted system event before authorizing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Their shipped #65085 fix is the closest overlapping routing change and provides the best starting point for comparing current behavior.
